r: Lists the IDs of all non-null secrets currently stored in the ultravisor for the currently running IBM Secure Execution guest. Only available on s390x.

<FILE>
Store the result in FILE. [default: '-']
--format <FORMAT>
Define the output format of the list. [default: 'human']
Possible values:
- human: Human-focused, non-parsable output format.

- yaml: Use yaml format.

- bin: Use the format the ultravisor uses to pass the list.

-h, --help
Print help (see a summary with -h).
